title: عمق کاشت بذر جو در خاک سبک و سنگین؛ خطاهای رایج

pending_issues.detail: Geographic scope altered: source lists both Wisconsin and the northwestern US as the evidence basis ('اقلیم ویسکانسین و شمال غرب آمریکا'), but target replaces this with only 'northwestern US,' dropping Wisconsin and narrowing the stated scope in a way not supported by the source.

Unsupported addition: target inserts the phrase 'mechanical stress pressure' in the sentence about nitrogen management. This concept does not appear in the source (id=14), which only states that excessive nitrogen causes lodging and reduces grain quality. The insertion changes the meaning and introduces terminology absent from the source.
